body: Asked by the Dig Dug research, which needs Atari's SP-203 to settle how cocktail mode is selected. Covers switches, cocktail flip, clocks, controls, video and sound circuits. Recorded on avoidmissingball branch schematics-rule (0914c52), in review.
summary: Research may read the CPU games' board schematics for hardware wiring only; ROM listings printed with them stay banned
